en: Black-and-white postcard view of a semi-rural street with a large wooden house behind a picket fence and tall pine trees on the right, and smaller houses and buildings further back on the left. There is an unpaved road in the foreground with simple wooden railings and utility poles with overhead wires. The scene is calm and residential. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and right corners.
